frozen_candidate.rule: The candidate compiler is imported and executed byte-for-byte unchanged. R15F may change only the post-terminal verifier.

protocol: Run the frozen candidate to a terminal extended interface before constructing either semantic verifier.
Construct one incremental Minisat22 solver over the original GENERAL_CNF frame and one incremental Glucose4 solver over the completed extended candidate CNF.
For each bridge mask 0..65535, query each solver using bridge literals only as assumptions. Internal/or auxiliary variables remain existential.
Replay every SAT model directly against the corresponding CNF and the bridge assumptions.
Compute allowed-mask lists independently and hash them with sha256(json.dumps(allowed,separators=(',',':'))).
Require the original-frame hash to equal the frozen R13/R14 exact witness hash before interpreting candidate comparison.
Compare the complete allowed-mask sets, not a sample panel.

generalization_rule: Only R15F_FULL_DOMAIN_SEMANTIC_MATCH authorizes creation of R16 prospective unseen holdout with the candidate logic frozen byte-for-byte. A mismatch freezes the candidate as failed calibration. A verifier resource limit authorizes only verifier recovery, not candidate tuning.
claim_ceiling: A MATCH would establish exact semantic equivalence on exposed W05 only. It would not establish unseen generalization, a polynomial runtime envelope, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT in P, or P=NP.
